subject: GetYourGuide day tours from London that include Stonehenge
source: data/day-trips/gyg-inventory.json for the product set (destinations.Stonehenge, 60 ids), then product pages opened one at a time in the browser at https://www.getyourguide.com/en-gb/activity/-t<id>. Price, rating and review count taken from each page's own application/ld+json Product block; includes and excludes read from the inclusions accordion in the rendered DOM.
method: Nine pages were already read during the inventory pass (657, 219849, 61147, 16096, 50354, 70842, 52393, 156657, 945). Nineteen more were opened on 12 September 2026, eighteen of them new. Twenty-seven of the sixty Stonehenge products have now had their includes and excludes lists read. Curl returns 403 on product pages after a couple of requests; the browser with a throttle between loads works, though three pages refused to render at all - see notVerified.
theTest: A product is only recorded as entry-included when the word 'entry', 'entrance', 'admission' or 'access' appears in the inclusions list with no conditional clause after it. 'if option selected', 'ONLY if option selected', 'if purchased', 'if selected' and 'If This Tour Option is Selected' all count as conditional, whatever the title says.

entryConfirmedIncluded.priceAnomalyResolved: The inventory recorded a GBP 27 page 'from' price for this product and flagged it as below the gate ticket. That GBP 27 was the Stonehenge Admission Ticket card in the page's 'You might also like' rail, not this product. The page's own ld+json lowPrice is 36.8, and both of its two options carry the entrance fee unconditionally. No anomaly. The operator is Premium Tours and there is no live guide, which is where the saving comes from.
